fields.text: CRC polynomial: bit k stands for the x^k term. The lowest term is fixed at 1 inside and bit 0 is ignored. An 8-bit example: x8 + x7 + x3 + x2 + 1 is 1 1000 1101.

fields.text: IEEE 802.15.4 energy detect level. To bring it to the IEEE 802.15.4 range, multiply by ED_RSSISCALE with 8-bit saturation.

fields.text: Correlator threshold for CCA busy; used only in CarrierMode, CarrierAndEdMode and CarrierOrEdMode.

fields.name: CCAEDTHRES
fields.text: Energy threshold for CCA busy, used in every CCA mode but CarrierMode. Divide the IEEE 802.15.4 value by ED_RSSISCALE to get it, as with EDSAMPLE.

fields.text: Selects how CCA decides the channel is busy.

values.text: Energy: busy whenever energy over CCAEDTHRES is detected.

values.name: CarrierMode
values.text: Carrier: busy whenever a compliant IEEE 802.15.4 signal is detected.

values.name: CarrierAndEdMode
values.text: Busy when energy is over threshold and a carrier is detected.

values.name: CarrierOrEdMode
